Maintain the reference's grey tracked tank identity and concrete futuristic base architecture. No text of any kind, no logos, letters, numbers, buttons, card borders, interface, phones, screens, collage, montage, watermarks or floating graphic shapes. No neon fantasy weapons or cartoon styling. Keep important subjects wholly inside the image with generous edge clearance for center-crop. A large grey angular tracked cannon tank occupies the right foreground in front three-quarter view facing left, its cannon aimed gently toward the left; full tracks and turret visible, recognizable silhouette. On the left midground a commanding concrete base with a large satellite dish. Cold rocky mountain battlefield at dawn, restrained pale peach horizon behind blue-grey ridges. Hero tank is dominant and carefully detailed. The lower 12 percent naturally fades through dark rocky shadow into nearly uniform deep navy #071521 so the actual app can transition below it. There must be no title, topographic overlay, UI or empty fake text panel.
